description_en: Modifies a custom control policy by calling UpdateControlPolicy
description_zh: 调用UpdateControlPolicy修改自定义管控策略
name: UpdateControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the control policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The new Policy Name of the control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, must start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: new_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length, must start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: new_description

parameters.help_en:
The new document of the control policy.

The maximum length is 4,096 characters.

For information about the control policy language, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html.

For examples of control policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html。

管控策略示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.name: new_policy_document

ControlPolicy.description_en: The details of the control policy

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of times the control policy is referenced
AttachmentCount.description_zh: 管控策略被引用的次数

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was created. The time is displayed in UTC in RFC 3339 format, indicated by Z
CreateDate.description_zh: 管控策略创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the control policy

EffectScope.description_en:
The effective scope of the control policy. Valid values:

All: The control policy takes effect for Alibaba Cloud accounts, Resource Access Management (RAM) users, and RAM roles.
RAM: The control policy takes effect only for RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The Policy Name of the control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

System: system control policy.
Custom: custom control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was updated. The time is displayed in UTC in RFC 3339 format, indicated by Z
UpdateDate.description_zh: 管控策略更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC
